pizza_margherita.name: Margherita Pizza
pizza_margherita.description: Classic Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil on a crispy thin crust. Made with our signature tomato sauce.

pizza_pepperoni.name: Pepperoni Pizza
pizza_pepperoni.description: Traditional pepperoni pizza loaded with premium pepperoni slices and melted mozzarella cheese on our hand-tossed crust.

pizza_quattro_formaggi.name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza
pizza_quattro_formaggi.description: Four cheese pizza featuring mozzarella, gorgonzola, parmesan, and fontina cheeses. A cheese lover's dream!

pasta_carbonara.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
pasta_carbonara.description: Creamy Italian pasta with crispy pancetta, egg yolk, parmesan cheese, and freshly ground black pepper.

pasta_bolognese.name: Pasta Bolognese
pasta_bolognese.description: Rich and hearty meat sauce slow-cooked with tomatoes, carrots, and celery, served over fresh tagliatelle pasta.

pasta_alfredo.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
pasta_alfredo.description: Silky fettuccine pasta tossed in a rich, creamy parmesan sauce. Simple yet incredibly satisfying.

salad_caesar.name: Caesar Salad
salad_caesar.description: Crisp romaine lettuce, crunchy croutons, shaved parmesan, and our house-made Caesar dressing.

salad_caprese.name: Caprese Salad
salad_caprese.description: Fresh buffalo mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, and fragrant basil drizzled with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze.

salad_garden.name: Garden Salad
salad_garden.description: Mixed greens with cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, and carrots. Served with your choice of dressing.

appetizer_bruschetta.name: Bruschetta
appetizer_bruschetta.description: Toasted Italian bread topped with fresh diced tomatoes, garlic, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil.

appetizer_garlic_bread.name: Garlic Bread
appetizer_garlic_bread.description: Warm, crusty Italian bread brushed with garlic butter and herbs. Perfect for sharing!

dessert_tiramisu.name: Tiramisu
dessert_tiramisu.description: Classic Italian dessert with layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream, dusted with cocoa.

dessert_panna_cotta.name: Panna Cotta
dessert_panna_cotta.description: Silky vanilla cream dessert topped with fresh berry compote. Light and refreshing.

dessert_gelato.name: Gelato Trio
dessert_gelato.description: Three scoops of authentic Italian gelato. Choose from chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, or pistachio.
